parts.html: The K-16 standard model is a neoclassical L-shaped kitchen in a striking green. Solid-color fronts and clean geometry combine classic aesthetics with modern comfort.
Green creates a calm, cozy atmosphere and pairs well with light walls, wood, stone, and decor in warm neutral tones.
Neoclassicism keeps the elegance of a traditional interior without excess decoration, so the K-16 is at home in both a modern apartment and a private house.

The kitchen’s defining feature is its 4.6-linear-meter L-shaped layout: work surfaces, built-in appliances, and cabinets run along two adjacent walls, and with no island there is room left for a dining area.
All the fronts are foil-wrapped in a single shade of green, emphasizing the understated character of neoclassicism.
The cargo pull-out helps make smart use of cabinet space, while Muller soft-close hinges and telescopic slides close the doors and drawers smoothly.
We will tailor the K-16 to your kitchen — with different cabinet sizes, a different work surface configuration, and a front shade chosen to match your interior.
